note: What a client sends to cast something from a slot, at a point or at a unit. The header names the sender's champion.

bits.name: fromSummonerSlots
bits.note: Set where the slot counts among the summoner slots rather than the unit's own.

bits.name: fromHud
bits.note: Set where the cast came from clicking the panel rather than the world.

bits.name: unknown
bits.note: Unused; its bits carry no meaning.

fields.name: slot
fields.note: Which slot is being cast from. It names slots for a unit's own spells and for items alike.

fields.name: x
fields.note: A point on the ground the cast is described by, along one axis, in world units.

fields.name: z
fields.note: The same point, along the other axis, in world units.

fields.name: endX
fields.note: A second point, along one axis, in world units. A client sends the same point here as in x and z. Which of the two is where the cast begins and which is where it is aimed is undetermined.

fields.name: endZ
fields.note: The second point, along the other axis, in world units.

fields.name: target
fields.note: The network object aimed at, or zero where the cast is aimed at ground.
